title: Procedure File: 2026/0265(COD) | Legislative Observatory | European Parliament

triage.reason: The procedure file shows a new step in the Public Procurement Act (2026/0265(COD)): committee referral announced in Parliament on 11/11/2026, within the last 60 days, advancing the proposal published 09/09/2026.

draft.summary: On 11 November 2026 the committee referral of the legislative proposal 2026/0265(COD) was announced in the European Parliament at first reading. The procedure is an ordinary legislative procedure (COD) for a regulation, and the stage reached is recorded as awaiting committee decision.
draft.source_quote: | 11/11/2026 | Committee referral announced in Parliament, 1st reading |  |  |

key_dates.text: Committee referral announced in Parliament, 1st reading

draft.interpretation: With the file now in committee, the Parliament's scrutiny of the procurement rules can begin, which is the point at which amendments affecting circularity and recycled-content criteria in tenders would first be tabled.
